// diagnostic

E3312

Provider `{provider}` for `{capability}` on target `{target}` has invalid digest `{sha256}`.

What

Provider `{provider}` for `{capability}` on target `{target}` has invalid digest `{sha256}`.

Why

Every selected provider needs a stable identity and sha256 provenance so artifacts cannot reuse changed target behavior.

Fix

Declare a nonempty provider identity and a `sha256:` digest for `{capability}`.
